text:
oncall-bot: PAGE: Incident 23456 - Customer 'BlueWave' reporting connectivity anomalies to Redwood PrivateConnect in eu-south (AZ-b). Pager link: https://incidents.internal/23456 :rotating_light:

sara.ops: ack — looking. Customer says intermittent 5-30s blackholes, TLS handshakes failing, and some API calls timing out.

nate-net: grabbing BGP / route tables now. Can you paste customer circuit IDs and a traceroute?

mike-support: customer DM'd: times: 12:03-12:12 UTC, 12:27 UTC. They saw traffic take eu-west1 then drop. Provided traceroute to our privatelink endpoint:

```
traceroute to priv-xyz.bluewave.internal (10.20.30.40), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.4 ms
 2  10.254.7.1  0.8 ms
 3  203.0.113.45  22.3 ms
 4  198.51.100.2  23.9 ms
 5  * * *
```

anjali-ps: circuit IDs: DC-1221-GL, DX-334-eus. Customer uses backup peering via eu-west; primary is eu-south AZ-b.

nate-net: BGP summary from our edge shows repeated withdraws for prefixes to customer in eu-south-AZ-b around 12:02 and 12:26. Logs: "BGP session reset by peer" from cloud fabric IP 198.51.100.2.

luis-sre: checking infra inside Redwood — no host-level CPU/disk/iface spikes for privatelink frontends. Latency within cluster is normal. This looks like an external fabric problem or interconnect.

oncall-bot: NOTE: automatic runbook triggered -> runbook/privateconnect-bgp-flap. Next step: escalate to cloud vendor NOC after initial verification.

sara.ops: I opened a live ticket with vendor (TICKET-CC-9988). Sent them BGP timestamps and pcap capture from our edge. Waiting on vendor ack. Escalation level 2.

cloud-vendor-bot: Vendor ack: "Received BGP logs, investigating metro fabric mux in eu-south AZ-b. Expected update in 15m."

mike-support: Customer is on the call and wants ETA. I told them vendor acked and we're doing failover testing.

nate-net: Proposing mitigations while vendor triages: 1) push temp localpref de-prioritization of eu-south routes so traffic uses eu-west backup, 2) add static route for critical control-plane prefixes to force via backup DX, 3) enable per-connection retry backoff on privatelink proxies. Thoughts?

anjali-ps: Customer approves temporary traffic shift to eu-west. They warned about slight latency increase but prefer availability.

luis-sre: Agree with localpref change. Doing canary for subset of prefixes (control-plane only) first. If stable for 3m, roll full prefix set.

sara.ops: Applying localpref change now to edge-routers in eu-south: 

```
# bgp neighbor 198.51.100.2
set as-path prepend 65001 65001
set local-preference 50
```

sara.ops: applied to 2/3 routers. Monitoring flows.

deploy-bot: rollback guard: held off any infra deploys touching privatelink routes until incident clears.

~ 2 minutes later ~

nate-net: Canary traffic shifted — control-plane routes are now coming via eu-west and the customer sees no TLS failures for control APIs. Traces show path via 203.0.113.57 now.

mike-support: customer confirms decreased errors. Still seeing occasional spikes in request latency (p95 ~ 1.2s -> 1.6s) but no timeouts.

cloud-vendor-bot: Vendor update: "Identified flapping MPLS cross-connect in AZ-b; engineering applying micro-repair (port remap)."

sara.ops: good progress. Recommendation: keep localpref in place until vendor confirms stable for 30m, then revert. Also add flow logs for 60m to validate no hidden drop.

anjali-ps: I've notified BlueWave CS and sent scheduled status updates. They want a post-incident RCA and timeline once resolved.

luis-sre: Action item: after resolution, we'll add a healthcheck that triggers automatic localpref failover if we detect >3 withdraws in 10m for a customer circuit. Filing ticket INFRA-517.

~ 20 minutes later ~

cloud-vendor-bot: Vendor: "Micro-repair complete, no further link flaps detected in last 12 minutes. Monitoring for 30 minutes per runbook."

sara.ops: rolling back localpref to normal on 3/3 routers.

nate-net: rollback done. Verifying BGP paths — prefixes are now preferred via eu-south again and stable. BGP uptime looks good.

mike-support: customer reports full recovery, thanks team. Sending confirmation that we're closing the incident after monitoring window.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 23456 - Status: RESOLVED (traffic failover -> vendor fabric repair). Impact: brief connectivity interruptions for BlueWave; mitigated via temporary route policy failover.

luis-sre: Postmortem owners: anjali-ps (customer communication), nate-net (network remediation), sara.ops (runbook updates). I'll draft RCA with vendor attachments.

sara.ops: Notes to include in RCA: timestamps of withdraws, vendor ticket ID TICKET-CC-9988, config snippets used for localpref, and decision timeline.

anjali-ps: I'll coordinate customer postmortem and share the draft with legal/compliance for any SLA concerns.

mike-support: Closing loop with BlueWave: sent final note + KB link: https://kb.redwood/privatelink-outages#23456 :thumbsup: 

sara.ops: adding retrospective item: test automated localpref flip + alerting for >2 BGP session resets in 5m.

luis-sre: thanks all. No further action right now. If vendor reopens, we'll reassign. :white_check_mark:
